## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the home-boundary bypass before merge because previews can expose files outside the selected home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds a 200-character file preview helper, a settings-file path helper, and tests for both. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before enforcing the home boundary — With `home=/srv/home` and `relative=../secret.txt`, `preview` returns `/srv/secret.txt` when it exists. `is_relative_to` checks lexical components, so traversal passes the guard; an internal symlink targeting an outside file also passes. — Callers can read text files outside the selected home directory wherever the application process has read permission. — Fix: Resolve both the home and candidate paths, check containment, and read the resolved candidate.
